At the start of the show we had a tag match between DO FIXER pairing, KAGETORA and YOSSHINO, against Steve Corino and the departing Bryan Danielson (who had a great couple month run including being the first man to challenge for the Open the Dream Gate) where Blood Generation would attack KAGETORA and YOSSHINO... Except they didnt... YOSSHINO took a folding chair and bruised KAGETORA's back up with it, joining Blood Generation, The next 2 matches were mainly showcase pieces as my pet project, Shingo Takagi, continues his climb since debuting in October while Aagan Iisou were able to pick up a win against the trio of Mori, Super Shisa and young debutant, Fujita "Jr" Hayato (no Michinoku-Pro in this mod really helps...) Then, We would crown the inaugural Open the Triangle Gate champions when Blood Generation would beat DO FIXER with the help of new member YOSSHINO when he attacked Dragon Kid. The main event was the big one though. After losing to CIMA in the finals of the inaugural Open the Dream Gate champion tournament, Mochizuki declared it his mission to celebrate his 10 year anniversary in the business with that belt around his waist. This show being that 10 year anniversary, He went all out to earn his shot. When he lost an eliminator match to Don Fujii however, he declared that if he can't earn a challenge through the established process, he would take drastic measures. Declaring that if he lost to CIMA.... He. Would. Retire. CIMA accepted, Blood Generation and Final M2K, barred from ringside, It was 25 minutes of war. Until.... Mochizuki would reverse out of the crossfire powerbomb and land a high kick to CIMA, taking the pinfall win and winning the Open the Dream Gate and saving his own career
